questions.q: Evaluate this claim: "The word 'lquhy' (the first employer) functions only as a proper noun identifying a character." Use textual evidence from pages 21-27 to defend or refute.
questions.a: Refute. "lquhy" appears 15+ times with shifting connotations: initially neutral employer (p.21 "lquhy vk;k"), then investigator (p.22 "lquhy us xsV osQ ckgj yxh"), then betrayer (p.26 "lquhy us mUgsa crk;k Fkk fd rkrq'k us fiQj dgk"), finally symbol of systemic exploitation (p.27 "lquhy dks dgk¡ ls irk pyk gksxk"). The name becomes a metonym for institutional indifference. Accepting the claim shows inability to track semantic evolution across narrative time.

questions.a: (1) "yM+dh ne cPpksa dks f[kyk cqykdj LowQy ykSV xbZ" (causative: made someone do something — transitive, labor context).
